mapper.sql: id, user_id, family, scheme, scheme_ver, address_index, address, salt, status, retired_at, deployed_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wallet_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY family, status, id DESC
SELECT FROM wallet_address WHERE active_key = CONCAT(#{userId}, ':', #{family}) FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO wallet_address (user_id, family, scheme, scheme_ver, address_index, address, address_key, salt, status, active_key) VALUES (#{userId}, #{family}, #{scheme}, #{schemeVer}, #{index}, #{address}, #{key}, #{salt}, 'ACTIVE', CONCAT(#{userId}, ':', #{family}))
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_address SET status = 'ACTIVE', active_key = CONCAT(#{userId}, ':', #{family}), retired_at = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND family = #{family} AND scheme = #{scheme} AND scheme_ver = #{schemeVer} AND status = 'RETIRED'
UPDATE wallet_address SET status = 'RETIRED', active_key = NULL, retired_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM wallet_address WHERE family = #{family} AND address_key = #{key} AND (status = 'ACTIVE' OR retired_at >= #{retiredSince})
SELECT FROM wallet_address WHERE family = #{family} AND address_key = #{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_address SET deployed_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND deployed_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO wallet_address_scheme (family, scheme, factory, implementation, parent, fee_address, params_key) VALUES (#{family}, 'FORWARDER', #{factory}, #{implementation}, #{parent}, #{feeAddress}, #{key})
mapper.select: SELECT ver, factory, implementation, parent, fee_address FROM wallet_address_scheme WHERE params_key = #{key}
SELECT ver, factory, implementation, parent, fee_address FROM wallet_address_scheme WHERE ver = #{ver}
SELECT ver, factory, implementation, parent, fee_address FROM wallet_address_scheme ORDER BY ver
